race.comment: BAY OF FIRES (6) won at Kilmore two runs ago but couldn't repeat the dose at his latest appearance over 1690m at Shepparton, beaten 6 metres. It doesn't get any easier but on his best form he is capable of a return to winning ways. WHERE IT BEGAN (11) made it two wins from two runs this prep at his latest appearance over 1770m at Albury, scoring by 5.5 metres after taking charge a long way from home. Draws out a little on the second line and may need luck at some point. Must raise the bar but he has the ability to test this field. HESOURCELEBRITY (4) is close to a win after two successive placings, the latest a second over 1740m at this track. Great chance to break through. AFTERSHOCK (7) disappointed last time but is a chance based on a good win over 1740m at this track two runs back.
